extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators and senior/key personnel preparing NIH grant application forms (profiles, biosketches) and Facilities & Other Resources descriptions
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare the NIH Senior/Key Person Profile and Biographical Sketch sections of a grant application, including required fields, education/training entries, personal statement, positions, contributions to science, and research support. Also describe institutional Facilities & Other Resources (instruments and capabilities) available to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — instrument capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe available core instrumentation and analytic capabilities relevant to the project (e.g., GC/MS with EI and GC/ECNI/MS, Agilent Triple Quadrupole mass spectrometers, Agilent LC/MSD Time of flight, Quadrupole TOF instruments, Agilent 6890 GC, Jasco HPLC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include specific instrument models and their technical capabilities (electron impact ionization (EI), GC/ECNI/MS, positive/negative ion capabilities, autosampler, on-column injector, ESI and APCI capability, MRM mode for directed metabolomics, high mass accuracy for accurate mass determination, tandem MS capability for structural information, UV/fluorescence/electrochemical/diode array detectors). Indicate what analytes can be measured (derivatized amino acids, low molecular polar and non-polar metabolites, nucleic acids, lipid metabolites, complex lipoproteins, glycolipids, sphingolipids, small molecules) and whether instruments support directed and/or untargeted metabolomic profiling, sample purification, and preparation of internal standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: PROFILE - Senior/Key Person required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide complete profile information for each Senior/Key Person, using the PROFILE form fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: Prefix; First Name*; Middle Name; Last Name*; Suffix; Position/Title*; Organization Name*; Department; Division; Street1*; Street2; City*; County; State*; Province; Country*; Zip/Postal Code*; PhoneNumber*; Fax Number; E-Mail*; Credential (e.g., agency login); Project Role* (e.g., PD/PI); Other Project Role Category; Degree Type; Degree Year; Attach Biographical Sketch; Attach Current & Pending Support. Follow the form's required/asterisked fields exactly and attach requested PDF files for biosketch and current & pending support.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the prescribed biographical sketch format for Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors and adhere to the page limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the specified sections in the order shown, and DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES. Begin Education/Training with baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include postdoctoral training and residency if applicable. Use the table fields: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, FIELD OF STUDY.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a personal statement summarizing long-term research goals, the objective of the proposed research, relevant prior work, unique qualifications to accomplish the aims, and any training plan or resources that support the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how your background and expertise position you to carry out the proposed project, reference prior related work, mention any infrastructure or funded resources being leveraged, state current appointment(s), and indicate how the requested award (e.g., K01) will provide resources to accomplish the research aims. Keep this concise and relevant to the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch B. Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.description: List positions and employment history chronologically with dates and institutional affiliations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide start and end years and job titles for each position (e.g., Research Technician 2003-2006, Assistant Professor 2013 - ). Include honors and other relevant roles as part of professional experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize key scientific contributions and provide representative citations that demonstrate content and methodological expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution area, describe the contribution in a few sentences and list representative publications (with citation details). Demonstrate impact (e.g., guideline authorship, policy/practice change, methodological advances). Provide a link to the Complete List of Published Work in My Bibliography for the full publication record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research support (grants and other funding) with project title, dates, overall goal, and your role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiate ongoing versus completed support. For each entry include start/end dates, funding source, project title, overall goal/aims of the project, and the individual's role (e.g., PI, Co-I, Site PI, Statistician). Include institutional or foundation awards used to set up infrastructure if relevant.
